name: SAND CRAB
description: A sand crab skitters sideways, claws raised and clicking.

name: RATTLESNAKE
description: A rattlesnake coils in the dust, tail buzzing a warning.

name: TROLL
description: A troll looms overhead, warty green hide crisscrossed with old scars that never quite healed shut.

name: WERE-BAT
description: A were-bat hangs upside down for a moment, then drops and unfurls leathery wings.

name: SLOTH
description: A sloth hangs from an overhead beam, moving with deceptive, lazy calm.

name: GIANT CLAW
description: A giant claw scuttles out of the shadows, snapping at the air ahead of it.

name: DRAGON!
description: A dragon rears back, smoke curling from its nostrils.

name: SKELETON
description: A skeleton rattles upright, empty sockets somehow finding you anyway.

name: SLICK EEL
description: A slick eel coils and uncoils, glistening and hard to get a grip on.

name: SLIME DEVIL
description: A slime devil oozes forward, its surface bubbling with something that smells like sulfur.

name: GILA MONSTER
description: A gila monster waddles closer, jaws working slowly -- once it bites down, it does not let go easily.

name: WEREWOLF
description: A werewolf drops to all fours, fur bristling, and howls.

name: DRACULA
description: Dracula sweeps his cape aside with a thin, hungry smile.

name: TRANTELLA
description: A trantella skitters on too many legs, mandibles clicking.

name: GARGOYLE
description: A gargoyle peels itself off the wall, stone grinding on stone.

name: SPITTING COBRA
description: A spitting cobra rears up, hood flared, already aiming.

name: MINOTAUR!
description: A minotaur snorts and paws the ground, horns lowered.

name: RED ORC
description: A red orc grunts and hefts its weapon, tusks bared.

name: MEDUSA
description: Medusa turns her head slowly, and you look away just in time.

name: TRIFFID
description: A triffid sways on its stalk, leaves rustling with no wind to explain it.

name: PIXIE
description: A pixie hovers just out of reach, wings a blur, grinning like this is all a game.

name: GORN
description: A gorn hisses and shifts its weight, scaled hide catching what little light there is.

name: GOLEM
description: A golem lumbers forward, cracks of runic light showing through its stone joints.

name: HYDRA
description: A hydra rears up on several necks at once, each head watching you separately.

name: CYCLOPS
description: A cyclops ducks under the ceiling, its single eye fixed unblinking on you.

name: GORGON!
description: A gorgon paws the ground, and where its gaze lingers the stone floor seems to dull and harden.

name: SERPENT
description: A serpent slides closer, tongue flicking to taste the air.

name: BRONTOSAURUS
description: A brontosaurus shakes the ground with every plodding step, tail sweeping wide.

name: WITCH
description: A witch cackles low in her throat, fingers already tracing something in the air.

name: BANSHEE
description: A banshee drifts closer, and the air goes cold around her.

name: SPIDER
description: A spider drops from above on a thin strand of silk, eight eyes catching the light.

name: CROCODILE
description: A crocodile surges forward in a burst of speed that seems impossible for something so heavy.

name: BLOB
description: A blob quivers and reshapes itself, absorbing whatever debris is in its path.

name: VAMPIRE
description: A vampire's eyes flash red, fangs bared in a cold smile.

name: STIRGE
description: A stirge darts erratically on buzzing wings, its needle-like proboscis already extended.

name: THOUL
description: A thoul shambles forward, its flesh sloughing slightly with every step.

name: TROGLODYTE
description: A troglodyte hisses, its scaled hide shifting color to blend with the rock behind it.

name: WIGHT
description: A wight reaches out with a hand that drains warmth from the air around it.

name: YELLOW MOLD
description: Yellow mold spreads across the ground in a slow, spore-releasing bloom.

name: ZOMBIE
description: A zombie shuffles forward, arms outstretched, dead eyes fixed on you.

name: GIANT SHREW
description: A giant shrew snuffles and darts forward, whiskers twitching.

name: WEREBOAR
description: A wereboar snorts and stamps a hoofed foot, tusks glinting.

name: MAGICIAN
description: A magician sweeps a hand through the air, muttering the first syllables of a spell.

name: LYCANTHROPE
description: A lycanthrope shudders mid-transformation, caught between two shapes and dangerous in both.

name: GHOUL
description: A ghoul crouches low, claws twitching, drawn by the smell of fresh meat.

name: GRAY OOZE
description: Gray ooze creeps across the floor, silently eating through anything it touches.

name: HARPY
description: A harpy shrieks and beats her wings, talons flexing.

name: HOBGOBLIN
description: A hobgoblin barks an order at nobody in particular and squares up to fight.

name: GOBLIN
description: A goblin bares crooked teeth and hefts a crude, notched blade.

name: GNOLL
description: A gnoll snarls, hyena-like laughter bubbling under its growl.

name: CARETAKER!
description: A caretaker eyes you warily, more startled than hostile.

name: RIVER RAT
description: A river rat bares yellow teeth, whiskers twitching with hunger.

name: GRIZZLY BEAR
description: A grizzly bear rises up on its hind legs, filling the space in front of you.

name: WRAITH
description: A wraith drifts forward, its edges never quite in focus.

name: GIANT
description: A giant plants its feet and hefts a club the size of a tree trunk.

name: OGRE
description: An ogre grunts and drags its club off the ground, ready to swing.

name: PERSIAN DESERTER
description: A Persian deserter grips his sword with the tired, wild-eyed look of a man with nothing left to lose.

name: ITLETS
description: The Itlets huddle together, chittering, before surging forward as one.

name: IT
description: It watches you from the shadows, shape hard to make out and harder to like.

name: THUG
description: A thug cracks his knuckles and grins like this won't take long.

name: DRUNKEN OLD MAN
description: A drunken old man sways on his feet, swinging wildly at nothing and everything.

name: BANDIT
description: A bandit draws his blade, eyes flicking to your purse before your face.

name: BLACK ANGUS BULL
description: A black Angus bull snorts, pawing the ground before it charges.

name: ITLET
description: An itlet chitters and bares needle-thin teeth.

name: GUARD ==[]
description: A guard steps forward, insignia catching the light, weapon already drawn.

name: GUARD -}---
description: A guard steps forward, insignia catching the light, weapon already drawn.

name: GUARD \|/
description: A guard steps forward, insignia catching the light, weapon already drawn.

name: SOMETHINGN
description: Something -- you're not sure what to call it -- writhes into a shape roughly like a threat.

name: WOOD DRAGON!
description: A wood dragon creaks and groans like old timber, bark-armored and breathing smoke.

name: RINGWRAITH
description: A Ringwraith turns toward you, and where its face should be there is only a deeper dark under the hood.

name: GOLLUM
description: Gollum crouches low, muttering to himself, eyes darting between you and something only he can see.

name: BATS
description: A cloud of bats bursts from the darkness, wings beating in a chaotic, deafening rush.

name: VAMPIRE
description: A vampire's eyes flash red, fangs bared in a cold smile.

name: BLUE DJINN
description: A blue djinn coalesces out of smoke, arms crossed, clearly unimpressed.

name: RATTLESNAKE
description: A rattlesnake coils in the dust, tail buzzing a warning.

name: XDRAGON!
description: A dragon rears back, smoke curling from its nostrils.

name: SCORPION
description: A scorpion raises its tail, stinger glistening and poised.

name: SCORPION
description: A scorpion raises its tail, stinger glistening and poised.

name: SWARTHY NOMAD
description: A swarthy nomad squints at you across the sand, curved blade already drawn.

name: LION
description: A lion crouches low, tail lashing, muscles coiled to spring.

name: RHINOCEROS
description: A rhinoceros paws the ground, lowering its horn.

name: TROLL
description: A troll looms overhead, warty green hide crisscrossed with old scars that never quite healed shut.

name: HEADHUNTER
description: A headhunter grins, fingering a necklace of trophies you'd rather not examine too closely.

name: BIG CHIEF
description: A big chief folds his arms, sizing you up before giving the signal to attack.

name: GIANT SQUID
description: A giant squid uncoils tentacle after tentacle, far more of them than seems fair.

name: SEA MONSTER
description: A sea monster rises from the water, dripping and enormous.

name: GREAT WHITE
description: A great white circles once, dorsal fin cutting the surface, before it turns toward you.

name: SEAGULL
description: A seagull wheels overhead, shrieking, and dives.

name: PIRATE
description: A pirate draws a cutlass and spits to one side, grinning through gold teeth.

name: GIANT PIRANA
description: A giant piranha thrashes at the surface, rows of teeth bared.

name: STONE GIANT
description: A stone giant grinds to its feet, cracks of lichen and moss shedding from its shoulders.

name: WRAITH-GUARD
description: A wraith-guard drifts into position, colder and more disciplined than the wraiths that spawned it.

name: RONNEY
description: Ronney squares up with a lopsided, unsettling grin.

name: MERMAID
description: A mermaid surfaces, hair drifting in the current, voice already rising into a song.

name: NESSIE
description: Something long and dark breaks the surface, then vanishes again before you can be sure what you saw.

name: TUNNEL RAT
description: A tunnel rat darts between your feet, more nuisance than threat -- until there are more of them.

name: MUMMY
description: A mummy shambles forward, trailing ancient, brittle wrappings.

name: ROTTEN ZOMBIE
description: A rotten zombie shuffles forward, flesh sloughing off with every step.

name: SKELETON
description: A skeleton rattles upright, empty sockets somehow finding you anyway.

name: SLIMEY THING
description: A slimy thing oozes toward you, leaving a glistening trail behind it.

name: ICE LIZARD
description: An ice lizard hisses, breath fogging in the cold air around it.

name: KING TUT
description: King Tut regards you from behind a gold funeral mask, entirely unbothered by being disturbed.

name: GUARDIAN
description: A guardian steps into your path, standing at rigid attention until you get too close.

name: KEEPER
description: A keeper watches you with cold, appraising patience, as if deciding whether you're worth the trouble.

name: SARUMAN
description: Saruman regards you with icy contempt, staff already glowing at its tip.

name: EVILYNN
description: Evilynn laughs, low and delighted, like your arrival is the best part of her day.

name: GUARD DROID
description: A guard droid pivots toward you, servos whirring, weapon systems cycling online.

name: RAD ZOMBIE
description: A rad zombie shuffles forward, faintly glowing and reeking of something that shouldn't be that color.

name: LIGHT TANK
description: A light tank rotates its turret with a mechanical whine, tracking you.

name: OGRE TANK
description: An ogre tank grinds forward on heavy treads, brute and armored in equal measure.

name: RABID TRIBBLE
description: A rabid tribble chitters and trembles, somehow both adorable and deeply concerning.

name: BLACK DROID
description: A black droid swivels toward you, red sensor light narrowing to a point.

name: C-3-P-0
description: C-3PO wrings his hands and mutters about the odds, then squares up anyway.

name: RECON TANK
description: A recon tank pings and whirs, sensors sweeping the room before it locks onto you.

name: XENOMORPH
description: A xenomorph unfolds from the shadows, inner jaw clicking.

name: TOMMYKNOCKER
description: A tommyknocker taps twice against the nearest wall, then grins in the dark.

name: EXP. BIO-UNIT
description: An experimental bio-unit twitches, stitched-together parts moving slightly out of sync with each other.

name: BERSERKER
description: A berserker roars and charges before you've even finished sizing them up.

name: SPACE AMOEBA
description: A space amoeba pulses and flexes, translucent and hungry.

name: OLD MAN
description: An old man squints at you, then sighs and raises his fists like he's done this before.

name: SERPENT
description: A serpent slides closer, tongue flicking to taste the air.

name: TIN MAN
description: The Tin Man raises his axe, joints creaking, in need of a little oil but plenty of nerve.

name: SCARECROW
description: The Scarecrow flops and staggers into a fighting stance, straw poking out at the seams.

name: LION
description: The Lion paces back and forth, working up his courage before he'll actually attack.

name: OZ
description: Oz's voice booms from everywhere at once, and for a moment the room fills with smoke and fire.

name: WICKED WITCH
description: The Wicked Witch cackles and raises her broom, green skin twisted into a sneer.

name: LITTLE DOG
description: A little dog yips and bares its teeth, more bark than bite -- probably.

name: ADAM & EVE
description: Adam and Eve stand together, sizing you up with matching, unreadable expressions.

name: BEE
description: A bee buzzes lazily, then locks onto you and speeds up considerably.

name: MUNCHKINS
description: The Munchkins cluster together and start chanting, working themselves up to something.

name: APPLE TREE
description: An apple tree creaks and twists, branches curling toward you like reaching arms.

name: ORCS
description: The orcs fan out, tusks bared, weapons already drawn.

name: THE WATCHER
description: The Watcher unfolds itself from the darkness, silent and unreadable.

name: HELLHOUND
description: A hellhound snarls, and where its breath touches the air it curls and smokes.

name: WILD HORSE
description: A wild horse eyes you warily, hooves stamping the ground -- looks like it could be tamed with the right approach.

name: DWARF
description: A dwarf squares his shoulders and grips his axe with both hands, beard bristling.
